objectives.text: Classify common collection operations (ArrayList get by index, contains on a list, HashMap get, TreeMap get) as constant, logarithmic or linear time using the costs the Java API documentation states
Predict how the running time of a constant, linear, n log n or quadratic piece of code grows when the input size doubles
Rewrite a nested-loop lookup as a HashSet or HashMap lookup and state its time complexity before and after

minutes.basis: intake planning estimate under the new-course rule in authoring/docs/tools/validators.md (budget at least ceil(max(estimator P50, modeledWorstPath)), 15-minute ceiling, no day-pool shares).
